description:
Cast Spawn-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Ulalek triggers twice, and Spawn-Gang Commander triggers once.
Resolve one of Ulalek's triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger from step 3, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
